picks.title: Oratomic raises $300M to build a viable quantum computer that needs only 20K qubits
picks.why_it_matters: A $300M round led by ARCH, Spark, and Khosla signals top-tier VCs are making major bets on quantum computing reaching commercial viability sooner than expected, potentially opening adjacent opportunities in quantum software and applications.

picks.title: Hugging Face's CEO on why companies are done renting their AI
picks.why_it_matters: The shift from API-dependent AI to owned open-source models creates startup opportunities in fine-tuning, deployment infrastructure, and vertical AI applications built on open foundations.

picks.title: Apple sues OpenAI for trade secret theft
picks.why_it_matters: This lawsuit highlights the intensifying AI talent war between incumbents and could make Big Tech employees more cautious about joining or founding AI startups, potentially affecting deal flow and founder availability.
